column1: Traffic reports will resume on Wednesday, March 11 at 4 p.m.

column4: All inbound lanes are shut down at Man O War Blvd due to a serious collision.  Traffic diverted to the outer loop of Man O War Blvd.
Traffic on the inner loop of Man O War Blvd diverted to Parkers Mill Road unless traveling to the airport.
The outbound left turn lanes from Versailles Road to Man O War Blvd toward the airport are shut down.
